subject.title: feat(ui): merge the voice level meter into the stop-voice pill and disambiguate the stop controls

question: Should Control UI adopt this specific integrated stop-voice pill design, including the accent waveform resting state, hover/focus stop glyph, and separate filled run-stop square?
rationale: The source-level UX problem is real and the patch is focused, but the final visual treatment is maintainer-owned product direction and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Accept the integrated pill
options.body: Proceed with the proposed meter-in-button design after normal review because it directly fixes the duplicated stop-control confusion with focused proof.

options.title: Request visual tweaks
options.body: Keep the implementation direction but ask for specific styling or accessibility adjustments before merge.

options.title: Keep current layout
options.body: Close or defer this PR if maintainers decide the separate meter row and matching stop controls should remain until a broader composer redesign.

recommendation.title: Accept the integrated pill
recommendation.body: Proceed with the proposed meter-in-button design after normal review because it directly fixes the duplicated stop-control confusion with focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the feature-history owner for the Talk meter and authored both the canonical issue and implementation candidate for this UX direction.
